releases.notes:
### Changelog:

**Changes:**

- [Mod] Updated mod descriptions for Forge and NeoForge

**Technical Changes:**

- Bumped max supported pack format to 81 for Java 1.21.7
- [Mod] Bumped NeoForge 1.21.5 dependency to require version 21.5.74 or newer
  - Beta versions of NeoForge 1.21.5 (versions 21.5.0 to 21.5.73) are no longer supported

### Compatibility:

- Minecraft Java 1.21.5 - 1.21.7
- Fabric & Quilt with [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) for 1.21.5-1.21.7
- NeoForge:
  - for 1.21.5: 21.5.74 or newer
  - for 1.21.6: 21.6.0 or newer
  - for 1.21.7: 21.7.0 or newer
- Forge:
  - for 1.21.5: 55.0.0 or newer
  - for 1.21.6: 56.0.0 or newer
  - for 1.21.7: 57.0.0 or newer

### Support:

Please report any issues or submit any feature requests on [GitHub](https://github.com/Classic36-Media/Silly-Eatables/issues) or [Discord](https://discord.gg/vZJSDjPcmu).

>[!TIP]
> .jar = Fabric/Quilt mod & Forge/NeoForge mod
> .zip = Data pack

releases.notes:
### Changelog:

**New Features:**

- Added “Super Sugar” recipe
  - Grants the following when eaten:
    - 3 Nutrition
    - 2 Saturation
    - Speed V for 5 seconds

![image](https://i.imgur.com/fS9o42R.png)

- Added Dragon Cake recipe
  - Why would you want to eat the Dragon Egg?
  - Grants the following when eaten:
    - 8 Nutrition
    - 10 Saturation
    - Levitation III for 5 seconds
    - Speed III for 60 seconds
    - Resistance III for 30 seconds
    - Strength II for 15 seconds

![image](https://i.imgur.com/5RKGwqE.png)

**Changes:**

- Added additional item requirements triggers for recipe unlocks
  - Recipes now unlock when you have all of the required items for that recipe, instead of just one.
- Rebalanced Nutrition, Saturation and Consume Time values for older recipes:

| Item Name | Old Values | New Values |
| :--: | :--: | :--: |
| | Nut. / Sat. / Time | Nut. / Sat. / Time
| Clump of Butter | 2 / 0 / 1.8s | 2 / 1 / 1.2s
| Clumpy Block of Butter | 4 / 2 / 3.8s | 5 / 7 / 2.4s
| Cotton Candy | 0 / 1 / 1.0s | 2 / 0.5 / 0.4s
| Dark Chocolate Bar | 3 / 1 / 1.2s | 4 / 4.5 / 0.8s
| Dirt Cake | 7 / 3 / 4.5s | 5 / 3 / 2.4s
| Enchanted Golden Carrot | 6 / 14.4 / 1.6s | Unchanged
| Explosive Treat | 2 / 0 / 1.6s | 2 / 0.5 / 1.6s
| Milk Chocolate Bar | 3 / 1 / 1.2s | 4 / 3.5 / 0.8s
| Mud Pie | 4 / 2 / 1.6s | 4 / 2.5 / 2.4s
| Nugget of Butter | 0.5 / 0 / 0.5s | 1 / 0.5 / 0.4s
| Orange Chocolate Bar | 3 / 1 / 1.2s | 4 / 4 / 0.8s
| Rock Cake | 7 / 3 / 4.5s | 4 / 3 / 2.4s
| Smooth Block of Butter | 4 / 2 / 3.2s | 7 / 9 / 2s
| Stick of Butter | 2 / 0 / 1.1s | 3 / 2 / 0.8s
| Strange Potato | 1 / 0 / 1.6s | 2 / 1 / 1.6s
| Sugar-coated Bedrock | 5 / 3 / 10s | 6 / 4 / 6s
| Sugar-coated Obsidian | 2 / 1.5 / 7.5s | 5 / 4 / 4s
| Sugar Glass Block | 1 / 1.5 / 1.5s | 2 / 1.5 / 1.6s
| Sugar Glass Pane | 0.5 / 0 / 0.5s | 1 / 0.5 / 0.8s
| Sweet TNT | 0.5 / 0 / 1.6s | 5 / 3 / 2.4s

- Food items that were previously always consumable can now only be eaten when the player is missing hunger points
  - Cotton Candy
  - Sugar Glass Block
  - Sugar Glass Pane
  - Sweet TNT

**Technical Changes:**

- Bumped max supported pack format to 80 for Java 1.21.6

**Bug Fixes:**

- Fixed Explosive Treat recipe unlocking with Cocoa Beans instead of Cookies

### Compatibility:

- Minecraft Java 1.21.5 - 1.21.6
- Fabric & Quilt with [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) for 1.21.5/1.21.6
- NeoForge:
  - for 1.21.5: 21.5.0 or newer
  - for 1.21.6: 21.6.0 or newer
- Forge:
  - for 1.21.5: 55.0.0 or newer
  - for 1.21.6: 56.0.0 or newer

### Support:

Please report any issues or submit any feature requests on [GitHub](https://github.com/Classic36-Media/Silly-Eatables/issues) or [Discord](https://discord.gg/vZJSDjPcmu).

>[!TIP]
> .jar = Fabric/Quilt mod & Forge/NeoForge mod
> .zip = Data pack

releases.notes:
### Changelog:

- Bumped pack format to 71 for Java 1.21.5
- Updated all item names to the new 1.21.5 format
- Increased Explosive Treat consume cooldown from 2 seconds to 4 seconds
- Brown & Blue Eggs can now be used in the Mud Pie recipe
  - Regular eggs will still work
- Added “Sweet TNT” recipe
  - Grants 10 seconds of Speed
  - Caution: may explode when eating
  - Cooldown of 4 seconds to prevent accidental stomach explosions

![image](https://i.imgur.com/eFWiQ8Q.png)

- Added “Milk Chocolate Bar” recipe

![image](https://i.imgur.com/mYAKi94.png)

- Added “Dark Chocolate Bar” recipe

![image](https://i.imgur.com/ey1RIn7.png)

- Added “Orange Chocolate Bar” recipe

![image](https://i.imgur.com/iGE4hAa.png)

### Compatibility:

This version is compatible with Minecraft Java 1.21.5.

### Support:

Please report any issues or submit any feature requests on [GitHub](https://github.com/Classic36-Media/Silly-Eatables/issues) or [Discord](https://discord.gg/vZJSDjPcmu).

>[!TIP]
> .jar = Fabric/Quilt mod, requires [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
> .zip = Data pack
